desc: Ideate the mathematical structure and generation strategy.
Implement Sieve of Eratosthenes to find all primes up to $10^6$.
Iterate over pairs of primes $(p, q)$ with $p < q$ to generate all integers $X \le 10^6$ of the form $p^k q^m$.
Compute the squares $N = X^2$ for all valid $X$, store them in a list, and sort the list.
Read the input $Q$ and the subsequent queries $A$.
For each query $A$, use binary search (`bisect_right`) on the precomputed list of squares to find the largest value $\le A$ and print it.
Ensure the solution handles the constraints ($Q \le 2 \times 10^5$, $A \le 10^{12}$) efficiently within the time limit.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Check execution time to ensure it meets the 2-second limit for $2 \times 10^5$ queries.
If any issues arise, debug and refine.
